requirements:
# Calculate Moving Average

- **Difficulty:** Medium (medium)

## Requirements

Write a function block FB that calculates and updates a moving arithmetic mean. The moving arithmetic mean is a method of averaging over consecutive data points, where each new data point replaces the oldest data point, and then the average is recalculated.

1. When cyclicExecution is TRUE, a new data value is automatically read and the moving average average is updated every scan cycle.
2. Provide an external trigger signal trigger, which reads a new data value and updates the moving average upon each rising edge.
3. Provide a reset function reset, which resets the moving average calculation when the reset signal is TRUE. If the window size is less than 1 or greater than 100, output an error status and status code.

The status parameter indicates the execution status of the program:
- 16#0000: Execution successful
- 16#8200: Window length setting error, please set a value between 1 and 100.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `cyclicExecution` | `BOOL` | When TRUE, periodic reading is performed, and trigger has no effect |
| Input | `trigger` | `BOOL` | External trigger signal, reads value upon each rising edge |
| Input | `value` | `LREAL` | Newly read data value |
| Input | `windowSize` | `INT` | The window size for the moving average, which must be between 1 and 100 |
| Input | `reset` | `BOOL` | Reset signal, resets the moving average calculation when TRUE |
| Output | `average` | `LREAL` | The moving average |
| Output | `windowSizeReached` | `BOOL` | FALSE: Maximum window width not yet reached TRUE: Maximum window width has been reached |
| Output | `error` | `BOOL` | FALSE: No error occurred TRUE: An error occurred during the execution of FB |
| Output | `status` | `WORD` | Status code |

scan_semantics: At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.
safety_priority: Invalid window returns an error before sampling.
Cyclic and trigger conditions cannot cause double insertion.
assumptions: During warm-up, average is the mean of the actual accepted samples; zero-filled unused capacity is excluded.
reset has priority over sampling for a valid window; it clears history and sets average=0 and windowSizeReached=FALSE.
Changing a valid windowSize clears history before any same-scan accepted sample. Invalid window sets error/status and does not accept or change history.

An invalid-window scan preserves average/windowSizeReached. Returning to a valid window clears error/status. Trigger edge history is updated on every invocation, including reset and invalid-window scans.
cyclicExecution accepts exactly one sample per scan and ignores the trigger. windowSizeReached becomes TRUE once the accepted sample count reaches windowSize.

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

Floating-point inputs and intermediate reference arithmetic are finite. Existing fixed traces retain their declared absolute tolerance; claims do not extend to arbitrary magnitudes without a separately specified numeric error policy.
LREAL average comparisons allow up to abs<=1e-5 (and matching relative precision on T2). P6 initializes previousTrigger=FALSE prior to scan k=0.

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

ltl.description: Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.
ltl.explanation: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
Window bounds are checked without silently accepting data.
A valid window clears configuration error.
The result is the arithmetic mean of the active window or zero when empty.
Both operands are Boolean propositions. previousTrigger[0]=FALSE; previousTrigger[k+1]=I[k].trigger on every invocation, including invalid/reset.
No event means no sample update.

Every constrained ACTUAL output satisfies the exact pinned input-driven reference transition and comparison policy. Finite observations can falsify this predicate; no completed unbounded proof is claimed.

atomic_propositions.history: Ghost ordered list of at most windowSize accepted samples, newest last.
atomic_propositions.historyAfter: history after clearing on reset/window change and adding one accepted sample, discarding oldest if full.
atomic_propositions.unchangedMean: average and windowSizeReached equal their pre-scan values.
atomic_propositions.interface names: Identically named sampled input or observed output.
atomic_propositions.meanOrZero: Arithmetic mean for a nonempty list, otherwise zero.
atomic_propositions.length: Number of samples in the history list.
atomic_propositions.windowChanged: Current valid windowSize differs from the last valid configured size.
atomic_propositions.previousTrigger: {"kind": "previous_sampled_input", "source": "I[k-1].trigger", "initial": false, "update": "After EVERY scan k, including invalid/reset/stop, store I[k].trigger"}
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehavior:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_PUB009(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehavior[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
previousTrigger初值FALSE且每次调用后=本拍trigger。valid=1<=windowSize<=100；非法时average/reached保持并报8200。有效窗口首次建立或改变、或reset时清空历史；非reset且cyclicExecution或trigger上升沿时追加value并保留最后windowSize项。average=空则0否则sum/n，reached=(n=windowSize)。初始历史空、average=0、reached=FALSE。
atomic_propositions.average: O[k].average: independently observed post-scan candidate value (LREAL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.windowSizeReached: O[k].windowSizeReached: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.error: O[k].error: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.status: O[k].status: independently observed post-scan candidate value (WORD); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.average=0.0, O_init.windowSizeReached=false, O_init.error=false, O_init.status=0.

specification_contract.observation: I[k] is sampled before execution; O[k] is observed after execution. Initial conditions apply before invocation zero.
specification_contract.normative_completion:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_PUB009(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehavior[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
previousTrigger初值FALSE且每次调用后=本拍trigger。valid=1<=windowSize<=100；非法时average/reached保持并报8200。有效窗口首次建立或改变、或reset时清空历史；非reset且cyclicExecution或trigger上升沿时追加value并保留最后windowSize项。average=空则0否则sum/n，reached=(n=windowSize)。初始历史空、average=0、reached=FALSE。
specification_contract.history_binding: I, O and Sref namespaces, initialization and updates are defined in normalized_specification.observation, history_bindings and reference_state_initial. Candidate output never drives Sref.
specification_contract.evaluation_scope: Versioned executable scan predicate plus LTL over interpreted predicates. No native checker encoding or completed formal proof is claimed.
specification_contract.transition_binding: Use normalized_specification.transition and exact pinned source snapshots.

normalized_specification.language: LTL over typed scan predicates; finite conjunction is a binding-time macro, not native NuSMV syntax.

transition.reference_binding: Persistent plc_agent.scan_contract.ScanContract('PUB009'); constructed once per independent case, current state is Sref[k].
transition.state_update: Exactly once per scan; mutations of sampled IN_OUT copies are reference effects, not observations.
transition.hash_encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; all line endings normalized to LF before SHA256

comparison.integer_boolean: exact type and value; no tolerance
comparison.float: finite; abs error<=1e-5; dictionary/list shape and non-float values exact
comparison.PUB008: only successfully converted channels[j].outputValue: abs<=1e-5 OR rel<=2e-6; all preserved/config fields exact
comparison.PUB017: Successful deletion constrains recipeID=0; other fields of that deleted slot are unconstrained for the deletion scan. Subsequent no-write scans preserve the sampled actual representation. This observer history is separate from the logical reference database.
comparison.TIME_LTIME: exact integer nanoseconds after IEC literal parsing
comparison.implementation: plc_agent.normalized_spec.NormalizedScanMonitor.step with output_matches (pinned sources); observer histories never drive the independent logical reference

observation.I[k]: deep-copied inputs immediately before invocation k
observation.O[k]: actual outputs immediately after invocation k, supplied by independent execution backend
observation.Sref[k]: independent reference state BEFORE k; unrelated to similarly named candidate variables
observation.initial: fresh instance BEFORE invocation 0; never substituted by O[0]
observation.X: next scan-sequence position; argument must be Boolean, not a numeric term
observation.time: dt_ms is observed elapsed time; public timers use physical time, SELF Tick/count timers use logical scans

previousTrigger.update: After EVERY scan k, including invalid/reset/stop, store I[k].trigger

auxiliary_state_bindings.Spre: Sref[k], before the invocation; initialized by reference_state_initial
auxiliary_state_bindings.Spost: Sref[k+1], after exactly one pinned transition on I[k]
auxiliary_state_bindings.first: k=0 (first invocation); distinct from the pre-invocation initial observation
auxiliary_state_bindings.pre-output: actual O[k-1] for OUTPUT (explicit history initial where declared); I[k] for caller-owned IN_OUT
auxiliary_state_bindings.previous-input: I[k-1] for k>=1; edge memory for BOOL requests initially FALSE and updated after EVERY invocation
auxiliary_state_bindings.reference_warning: Spre/Spost predicates are input-driven ghosts, not evidence that candidate internals match. Conclusions about the candidate must constrain actual O.

normalized_specification.reference_state_rule: Initial state is the serialized constructor above; all fields update solely through the pinned transition. Ghost phase/history/queue are names for this state, not observed candidate state.

primitives.bitwise: DWORD AND/NOT and popcount operate on unsigned 32-bit values; complement is masked by 0xFFFFFFFF.
primitives.time_literals: IEC TIME/LTIME literals are exact integer durations in nanoseconds.
primitives.observed_arrays: All IN_OUT inputs are snapshots before invocation; outputs are independently acquired after invocation. Physical bounds map by ordinal, never share another array lower bound.
primitives.boolean_next: X takes a Boolean formula. Numeric history transport is bit-expanded for DWORD; Boolean histories use equivalence.
primitives.time_progress: Timed eventuality clauses explicitly require G(F(TimeTick)); TimeTick denotes crossing a new integer-ms boundary. Finite observations cannot establish this premise.

assumptions: During warm-up, average is the mean of the actual accepted samples; zero-filled unused capacity is excluded.
reset has priority over sampling for a valid window; it clears history and sets average=0 and windowSizeReached=FALSE.
Changing a valid windowSize clears history before any same-scan accepted sample. Invalid window sets error/status and does not accept or change history.

An invalid-window scan preserves average/windowSizeReached. Returning to a valid window clears error/status. Trigger edge history is updated on every invocation, including reset and invalid-window scans.
cyclicExecution accepts exactly one sample per scan and ignores the trigger. windowSizeReached becomes TRUE once the accepted sample count reaches windowSize.

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

Floating-point inputs and intermediate reference arithmetic are finite. Existing fixed traces retain their declared absolute tolerance; claims do not extend to arbitrary magnitudes without a separately specified numeric error policy.
LREAL average comparisons allow up to abs<=1e-5 (and matching relative precision on T2). P6 initializes previousTrigger=FALSE prior to scan k=0.

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.
normalized_specification.domain_policy: Declared interface types and task assumptions apply. The pinned transition defines numeric/timing domains and rejects unsupported inputs. Reference exceptions are DOMAIN_OR_TOOL_ERROR, never candidate FAIL or PASS. Fairness/time-divergence assumptions concern infinite paths and are not proven by finite observations.
limitations: No ST-to-model translation or infinite-trace proof is implemented here.
Focused legacy LTL predicates still require backend lowering; normalization is not model-checker acceptance.
Finite matching cannot establish liveness or validate runtime provenance.
